drawings.prompt:
Create ACTUAL PRODUCTION sprite artwork, transparent background, a precise 3 by 3 atlas of nine isolated drawings, no text or grid. Bean species metamorphosis: the UNIT'S OWN BODY BECOMES A LIVING BUILDING. Image 1 is the exact unit identity (smooth ivory-green bean body, tiny two-leaf shoot, no mouth, no legs). Image 2 is the existing Level 1 nest identity. Design a modest provisional OUTPOST NEST, a simpler smaller cousin of that nest: the same bean skin opens into two thin smooth curved seed-pod shell sides surrounding a shallow living cradle and ONE SMALL matte pale seed. Keep natural grown anatomy: unified continuous plant tissue, ivory-green seed-coat with muted green edges, soft matte gradients, very few smooth folds, tiny green shoot. Friendly and calm, not a horror organ. NO WOOD, house, beams, planks, wicker, masonry, tent, architectural pitched roof, manufactured doors. NO gore, wet skin, veins, dangling sacks, tendrils, root fringe, teeth, mouths or legs. The shells must read as thin firm seed husks with clean narrow edges, not swollen bags or breasts. Camera fixed frontal three-quarter slight overhead RTS game art, warm upper-left lighting, controlled dark green outlines. Match reference unit's painterly shading and round anatomy.
Rows and cells left to right:
ROW 1 three complete animation KEY POSES, same ground center: 1) Original squat bean unit eyes closed, small simple flat leaf pad underneath, remains a recognizable unit. 2) SAME body wider and somewhat taller, two leaves on top, eyes absorbed, a single fine central shell seam developing; still closed and rooted, NO separate building. 3) FINAL OPEN OUTPOST: two thin ivory-green curved bean shell sides open upward around an empty shallow pale green cradle with ONE SMALL plain pale seed and tiny central shoot. It resembles reference nest but simpler, lower, unadorned. No roof or posts. Small simple flat leaf pad underneath. Root is at exact horizontal center in every cell, no diagonal drift.
ROW 2 INDEPENDENT ANIMATION PARTS matching pose 3 exactly: 4) complete LEFT thin curved shell side by itself, full hidden outline and clean alpha; rounded outer contour, concave inner contour, bottom hinge, one inward-turning upper tip; vertical shape with ONE contiguous filled interval per horizontal scanline, no holes or self overlaps. 5) exact matching RIGHT shell side. 6) ONLY shallow empty inner cradle/back bowl, front open, no shells, seed, sprout, floor or shadow. This is a smooth piece of living green bean tissue, not a woven basket.
ROW 3 separate parts: 7) simple broad flat low leaf pad with just three rounded overlapping leaf lobes, no frilly edge and no roots. 8) tiny complete two-leaf sprout with a short green fleshy stem, no seed or hull. 9) ONE SMALL matte pale seed, no light glow, no stem, no background.
Nine equal roomy cells, every drawing wholly isolated with generous transparent margin, part shapes should be broad and simple enough to rig cleanly. Do not render green solid backgrounds, checkerboard, captions or arrows.
